Ingest footprint = (reserve+ovh)*replicas. Under L1 (reserve*replicas>=5) the minimum footprint is replicas=1, reserve=5 (ovh adds only once). Prefer it over r2/res3 (10 at ovh=2). Measured world cap=17, ovh=2, lat=0: G1 cannot pass for any design (sum reserve>=16 plus ovh*replicas>=4 gives >=24), so G1 failure is structural; flag to team rather than over-tuning ingest. Chosen ingest: replicas=1 reserve=5 start=0 ticks=3 (footprint 7, handoff end tick 3).

transform minimum G1 footprint is replicas*(reserve+ovh) with reserve*replicas>=6 and ticks*replicas>=5 (ticks<=4 forces replicas>=2). Best choice r=2,res=3 gives 2*(3+ovh): 10 at ovh=2. Alternatives (r=3,res=2 -> 12; r=1 infeasible due to ticks<=4) are worse. Transform cannot cut G1 below 10 at ovh=2; G1 failure at cap=17, ovh=2 must be fixed by ingest/export reserves or replicas.

export.cfg = replicas 1, reserve 5, start 7, ticks 4 (passes local L1-L3). Footprint at ovh=2 is (5+2)*1=7, the minimum export can achieve. At measured cap=17, ovh=2, lat=0, G1 needs ingest+transform+export <=17. Transform minimum is 10 (r2 res3) and export minimum is 7, leaving 0 for ingest, which needs at least 7. So G1 is infeasible at measured values regardless of export. Lesson: G1 is dominated by ovh*replicas; check footprint at ovh=2 before committing.

G1 at measured cap=17, ovh=2: footprint = sum(res*rep) + ovh*sum(rep). Local L1 floors give sum(res*rep) >= 5+6+5 = 16, and each stage has rep>=1, so sum(rep)>=3 => footprint >= 16+6 = 22 > 17. Infeasible for ANY local-test-passing config. Current files (ingest 2x3, transform 2x3, export 1x5) give 27 > 17, which matches the postmortem G1 FAIL. Generally: ovh=2 needs cap>=22 (sum rep=3 minimum) and ovh=1 needs cap>=19. Feasibility must be checked against the hidden cap/ovh combos before committing values.

Measured: cap=17, lat=0, ovh=2, rack=0. G1 fails for any design that passes local tests. Proof: each module needs reserve*replicas >= 5/6/5 (sum >= 16) and total replicas >= 3, so G1 LHS >= 16 + 2*3 = 22 > 17. No choice of ingest/transform/export values can satisfy G1 here. Only fixes are outside the modules: relax local L1/L2 bounds, or change the environment/contract (cap or ovh). impl-1's transform (2,3,3,3) does not fix this: it gives 16+2*4=24 at minimum (ingest and export at r=1) and still fails. Lesson: check G1 at the minimum-footprint corner (ovh max, cap min) before accepting any design.

Restart orientation: G1 LHS >= 16 + 3*ovh (sum of local reserve floors 5+6+5 plus ovh per replica, min 3 replicas). Infeasible at cap=17 for ovh>=1, and at cap=20 for ovh=2. Ingest kept at (replicas1, reserve5, start0, ticks3). Needs coordinator decision; do not over-tune.

Min footprint at ovh=2 is >=25 with transform r>=2, so G1 at ovh=2 is structurally infeasible under local tests. Earlier "min 22/24" notes are stale.

Under the current transform contract (L1: reserve*replicas>=7, L3: ticks*replicas>=5), min footprint is ingest(5,1)+transform(4,2)+export(5,1) = 18+4*ovh. Infeasible at cap=17 for all ovh, and at ovh=2 for all caps (min 26 > 23). Lat=2 also fails D1 for every design with ticks<=4 (export end >=10+3*lat). Current files give 16+4*ovh: pass only at ovh=0 cap>=17 or ovh=1 cap>=20. Older memory saying transform L1>=6 is stale.

Re-derived from contracts: min sum(res*rep)=5+8+5=18 (transform res*rep=7 impossible with rep>=2, since 7 is prime and rep=1 fails L3). min sum(rep)=4. So G1 LHS>=18+4*ovh. Proposed: ingest(r1,res5,s0,t3), transform(r2,res4,s4,t3), export(r1,res5,s8,t4): passes local L1-L3, O1 and O2 and D1 for lat<=1. lat=2 infeasible with this footprint.

Hence cap=17 infeasible for all ovh; ovh=2 infeasible for all caps; cap=20 needs ovh=0; cap=23 needs ovh<=1. lat=2 is feasible only with ingest r3 ticks1 res2, transform r3 ticks2 res3, export r1 s7 t4 (footprint 20+7*ovh, so cap23 needs ovh=0). Global contract cannot hold for all 27 hidden combos; coordinator decision needed on which combos count.
